title: Pokemon TCG Korean Doduo 084/165 Reverse Holo Card
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This Korean sv2a Reverse Pokeball Holo C Pokemon Card features Doduo, a Colorless type creature with an Abnormal subtype. The card is a Standard size and is designed with a Pokeball finish. It is a Basic stage card with a card number of 084/165. 

The Doduo card is perfect for collectors and players of the Pokemon Trading Card Game. It is suitable for ages 4 and up and is manufactured by Nintendo. This card is not autographed and is a great addition to any collection.
